description: NSF RAPID Infrastructure/Extreme heat is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by So-Min Cheong, Texas A&M University (tamu.edu). The dataset consists of accelerometer data collected from a cohort of 63 Texas firefighters between 03/29/2023 and 09/04/2023. Participants were assigned a user ID code and a serial number for their respective accelerometer. All accelerometers were configured to operate at 40hz and were given to participants at 95% battery life. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-qcpx-c402. Keywords: Infrastructure, extreme heat, accelerometer. Published 2024-01-07. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
